name: QR Code Reader
summary: Decode QR codes from an image file or your camera — entirely in the browser.
description: Upload a QR image or scan with your device camera. Decoded text is shown instantly for copy. Uses jsQR locally — no image upload to a server.

faqs.question: Does the camera upload video?
faqs.answer: No. Frames are processed locally in your browser and never uploaded.

faqs.question: What image formats work?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and BMP. Clear, high-contrast QR codes decode best.

faqs.question: Camera permission denied?
faqs.answer: Use the file upload mode instead, or allow camera access in your browser settings.
